purpose: opt-in bounded completion of unowned returns near two original confident surface seeds
candidate_scope: only finite, in-range/in-FOV non-owner returns sharing a projection pixel with a selected original owner
requirements: direct pixel owner and one other original owner predict same target class at >=0.99
candidate within15cm of both original owners
no original owner of a different class with score>=0.9 within15cm
no propagation chains; original owner decisions never change
crowded neighborhoods abstain instead of truncating support/veto checks
sample_selection: three fixed intermediate frame IDs, not selected by predictions/labels/outcomes; validation split is not independent held-out model accuracy
adoption_gate: no automatic adoption; experimental output stays separate even if the small sample improves
diagnostic_gate: additional labelled target points >0, no additional labelled non-target removals, and no additional ignored removals; report each frame and both groups, including failures
